scope: Nine-line proposed-script.txt. No rendered-film, listening, or live playback review claimed.

lines.semantic_check: A purpose question about the sourced plan to engineer mineral-bearing rock and put it inside existing wells; no prior extraction, economic value or completed placement is implied.

lines.vo: SMU plans a test facility at an existing drilling site in Navasota.
lines.semantic_check: Plan, institution, location and test purpose are all sourced.

lines.vo: The team would engineer mineral-bearing rock, then place it inside existing wells.
lines.semantic_check: Future/conditional placement; no claim of rock being returned after extraction.

lines.vo: Drilling and sensing technologies could be tested, again and again.
lines.semantic_check: Supported repeat technology testing, not restoration of a damaged specimen.

lines.vo: The project would adapt oilfield automation for mining.
lines.semantic_check: Oilfield is a plain-language paraphrase of oil-and-gas technology transfer.

lines.vo: Students and workers would train with AI and digital twins, alongside hands-on practice.
lines.semantic_check: Would marks planned training; AI is training aid, not a model said to learn trial results.

lines.vo: For now, the Energy Department has selected the project for award negotiations.
These announcements report no completed testbed or test results.
lines.semantic_check: Absence is explicitly bounded to the two inspected announcements.

lines.vo: The rock goes in so the tools can be tested.
lines.semantic_check: Purpose summary within the established planned mechanism; no successful extraction claim.

required_visual_limits: Schematic animation must stay visibly framed as a proposed mechanism.
Never return a drilled specimen to intact condition; replace it for another test or use a cut to a separate test.
No measured trace can be styled as real project data; label schematic traces as illustrations.
Human training visuals must indicate planned activity.
Do not connect sensor output to an AI learning node unless explicitly marked as an unverified idea and omitted from factual narration.
